$comment: SYNTHETIC. The same mid-token prefix as issue-prefix-allowed.json, written
on the DENY side by someone shutting off the issue write.
It shuts off the reads too. `mcp__github__issue_*` is a character-offset
prefix in both directions, so the rule that was meant to reach one tool
reaches four, and an agent whose job is working an issue backlog silently
stops being able to read one. The allow rule above it is deliberately wide,
so a Denied verdict here is the deny arm firing rather than nothing matching.
